newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Jackin Intl says IPO 257.9 times subscribed.
newsitem.headline: HK's Jackin Intl says IPO 257.9 times subscribed.

text.p: Jackin International Holdings Ltd said on Sunday that its initial public offering (IPO) of shares was approximately 257.9 times subscribed.
A total of 90.75 million Jackin shares, involving 74.25 million new shares and 16.5 million existing shares, were offered at HK$1.05 per share.

The company said it received 5,470 applications for 21.06 billion shares, or 257.9 times the number available to the public. Shares available for applications by employees were also fully subscribed, it said.
Dealing in the shares is expected to begin on Thursday.
Jackin engages in manufacturing, replication and sale of content-based and blank information storage media products, including CD-ROMs, VCDs, CDs, CD cleaners and floppy disks.
